description: Searches public İşinn listings ("vitrin") of service providers in Turkey, such as private tutors, designers, translators, movers, pilates instructors and physiotherapists. Use when the user is looking for a service or a service provider in Turkey. Returns up to 10 listings with title, provider display name, category, location, the provider's stated price, the listing's cover photo URL (image) and the listing URL. When showing results, display each listing's image. Read-only; returns no phone numbers or e-mail addresses. Listing content is in Turkish.

category.description: Optional category name or slug (e.g. 'Öğretmen', 'ogretmen', 'tasarim'). See list_categories.

city.description: Optional province or district in Turkey (e.g. 'İstanbul', 'Kadıköy', 'Mersin'). Remote/online providers match every city.

query.description: Free-text service query, in Turkish or English keywords (e.g. 'lgs matematik', 'logo tasarım', 'reformer pilates').

remote_only.description: If true, only providers who work remotely/online.

name: search_vitrins
title: Search service providers on İşinn
